(Currently Amended) Claim 21: The airfoil according to claim 20, wherein the leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position are positive and in a range of 5° to 15°.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The airfoil according to claim 1, wherein the airfoil is a fan blade for a gas turbine engine having a trailing edge sweep angle defined by a curve that is differentiated by varying angles at each defined span position between 0% to 100% span. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 26: A gas turbine engine comprising: a combustor section arranged between a compressor section and a turbine section; a fan section having an array of twenty-six or fewer fan blades, wherein the fan section has a low fan pressure ratio of less than 1.55; and wherein the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 10° to 20° in a range of 40-70% span position, and the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0% span to at least 95% span. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: A gas turbine engine comprising: a combustor section arranged between a compressor section and a turbine section; a fan section having a low fan pressure ratio of less than 1.55; and wherein the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 10° to 20° in a range of 40-70% span position, and the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0% span to at least 95% span.

(Currently Amended) Claim 28: The gas turbine engine according to claim 27, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.52.

(Currently Amended) Claim 29: The gas turbine engine according to claim 28, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.50.
